card.name: Digits 5 and 9 in numeric tables
card.fires_on: The final digit 5 or 9 (sometimes 4) in decimal numbers or numbered items. It appears in dosing tables, week or month columns, and section numbers.

modes.label: Decimal table values
modes.description: Last digit of a decimal in a dose or rate table, such as 0.25 or 0.19.

modes.label: Section or period numbers
modes.description: A 5 or 4 in a section number or a week or month label.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of numbers in tables, mostly 5 or 9, such as 0.25 in a dose chart.
